headline: Bank of England: mortgage payments to jump for millions
pages: About 6.5 million UK homeowners are forecast to see monthly mortgage payments rise by an average of 100 pounds when they refinance by the end of 2029, the Bank of England said in its Financial Stability Report. That is more than double the 45 pound rise it estimated in July. About one million owners on rates below 3% who refinance by the end of next year face an average rise of 200 pounds. Average rates on two and five year fixed mortgages stand near six percent, the highest in about three years, according to Moneyfacts. The Bank said the average rise is half that seen by those refinancing in 2023 and 2024. It raised its benchmark rate to 4% earlier this month.
Around 350,000 borrowers are expected to see payments fall. Source: BBC.
